result.summary: Found a few visual issues: the bottom restaurant card is partially hidden by the fixed navigation bar, and some text/cards are clipped or low-contrast, which hurts readability and polish.

issues.description: The first card in the "Popular right now" section is cut off at the bottom by the fixed bottom navigation bar, so part of the content is obscured.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/scroll space to the feed so the last visible card clears the navigation bar and remains fully readable and tappable.

issues.description: The rightmost card in "Fastest near you" is partially clipped on the right edge, with the title truncated and the card not fully visible.
issues.suggestion: Increase horizontal padding or adjust the carousel spacing so cards are either fully visible or intentionally cropped more clearly as a scrollable list.

issues.description: The promotional banner uses very light text on a pale green background, which appears low-contrast and harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the text or the banner background to improve contrast and readability, especially for the headline and subtext.
